title: DEROTOX : DEgenerative ROtator cuff disease and botulinum TOXin
official: DEROTOX : DEgenerative ROtator cuff disease and botulinum TOXin
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of botulinum toxin in the treatment of degenerative tendinopathy of the rotator cuff of the shoulder, at one month, based on the Shoulder Pain And Disability Index score (SPADI total)

interventions.name: XEOMIN 100 unités, poudre pour solution injectable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age > 40 years
2. Availability for visits planned by the protocol
3. Use of an effective method of contraception in women of childbearing potential that began at least 1 month before and continues for at least 1 month after administration of study treatment
4. Negative urine test for women of childbearing age
5. Duration of pain > 1 month
6. Pain intensity ≥ 40/100 on the visual analog scale
7. SPADI score ≥ 30/100
8. Pain medication(s) unchanged within 30 days prior to enrollment
9. Pain with or without weakness during the Jobe maneuver
10. Ultrasound within 30 days, showing supraspinatus tendinopathy, with or without rupture
11. Affiliation to a social security scheme
12. Ability to give consent, complete the weekly notebook (collection of medicinal treatments taken for pain)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Reduced passive range of motion
2. Concomitant use of aminoglycosides, cyclosporine, aminoquinolines or spectinomycin
3. Participation in other interventional research (RIPH) during the 3-month follow-up period of DEROTOX Research. Participation in another RIPH will be possible beyond these 3 months.
4. Patients with a history of inhalation pneumonitis and dysphagia
5. Patients on anticoagulant therapy or on therapy likely to have an anticoagulant effect
6. Patients with bleeding disorders
7. Patients suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, myasthenia gravis or Lambert-Eaton syndrome.
8. Patients with other disorders leading to peripheral neuromuscular dysfunction
9. Weakness or pronounced atrophy of the supraspinatus muscle
10. Women of childbearing age who have not taken a urine pregnancy test or who have taken a positive urine pregnancy test
11. Pregnancy, breast-feeding
12. Skin infection at the intended injection site
13. Botulinum toxin injections within the last 6 months
14. Vulnerable persons (under legal protection, guardianship or curatorship).
15. Glenohumeral arthropathy
16. Painful acromioclavicular arthropathy
17. Neurogenic upper limb pain
18. Glenohumeral instability
19. Tendon calcification
20. Ultrasound showing a concomitant rupture of the infraspinatus or subscapularis
21. Infiltration of corticosteroids into the shoulder in the 30 days preceding the inclusion visit
22. Shoulder surgery
23. Humeral fracture, inflammatory rheumatism or neoplastic disease
24. Contraindication to XEOMIN® (hypersensitivity to XEOMIN® or to one of the excipients or to any other botulinum toxin product, generalized disorder of muscle activity, in the event of infection or inflammation at the injection site concerned)
